assignments.scenarioTitle: Why Do People Keep Attacking My Dungeon?
assignments.why: a mid-tier dungeon owner managing staff between trap rebuilds is where the Academy's graduates end up, and the workplace satire is the same joke told later

assignments.scenarioTitle: It's My Birthday So I Kidnapped a Princess and Today We're Getting Married
assignments.why: a villain whose romantic plan nobody talked them out of is exactly what an academy for villainy fails to teach against
lairs come onto the market when their owners graduate, retire or lose a bet, and the Academy is the institution that produces all three
four open roles on a dark-empire org chart is a recruitment fair, and this is the school it recruits from
a ship whose doors sigh and whose vents complain is the only vessel that would let a couch file a flight plan
a crew that looks nothing like the recruitment posters is who the gold envelope actually picks, and each realm is another improbable stop
four life-signs the manifest does not admit to is a very Starcruiser problem: the ship is held together by mutual respect and nobody counted
